name: CertManagerSaaS - Fetch Classifier
description: Classifies issues fetched by the Certificate Manager SaaS and Next-Gen Trust Security integrations by the IssueType key the fetch writes into rawJSON: certificate expiry or failed key-compromise revocation. XSIAM ignores the type an integration sets on a fetched issue, so without this classifier every issue gets the instance's Incident type. A custom expiry type chosen on the instance isn't in the map, so the instance setting still applies to it.
